keyFindings.summary: Configured delivery is not observed delivery; Cursor's tested prompt lane is zero and other host receipts remain qualified.
Every named block has an exact semantic owner and lifecycle lane across all six runtimes.
Gate read-only and terminal cases are already silent; savings apply only to repeated mutation-positive open-epoch emissions.
Measured blocks: directives 763 B, route 43 B, Gate 521 B, Pi 554 B, representative SessionStart 389 B.
OpenCode known components are parameterized by transform count, continuity, and an uncapped compiled summary; whole-prompt totals remain unknown.
Priority is instrumentation, bounded OpenCode summary, identity-proven same-message dedup, route-only evaluation, Gate evaluation, then Pi prototype.
SessionStart is lifecycle-scoped; suppression requires verified replay after resume/compaction and unknown state must emit.
Stable-prefix placement can improve eligibility but no billed-cache saving is measured; caching is not semantic deduplication.
Ten-turn shared configured baseline/recommended is 9,626 to 1,715 B; Pi is 15,189 to modeled 3,478 B; Cursor observed remains zero.
The 130-byte Pi reminder and 177-byte repeat composite are modeled targets and not proven semantically equivalent.
The 763-byte directives fallback is 94.7% of the representative 806-byte advisor payload.
Use a shared identity/policy planner with native serializers, host receipts, lifecycle epochs, and fail-safe emission.
